title: C2SP Transparency Log Verifier
description: Verifies a C2SP checkpoint (signed note) and an RFC 6962 inclusion proof against a C2SP tlog-policy trust policy, entirely client-side. Parses the note framing, matches every signature line against the policy's log and witness keys, verifies the log signature and each tlog-cosignature, evaluates the policy quorum rule, replays the inclusion path against the root the checkpoint carries, and optionally decodes a tlog-tiles path to confirm it is the tile holding the leaf.

checkpoint.description: C2SP checkpoint as signed-note text: origin, tree size, base64 root hash, optional extension lines, a blank line, then one signature line per signer

policy.description: C2SP tlog-policy text (log / witness / group / quorum lines). Keys are read as a signed-note vkey or as bare hex

proof.description: RFC 6962 inclusion proof for one leaf against the checkpoint's own tree size and root

leaf_value.description: Hex leaf hash, or hex raw leaf bytes when leaf_mode is bytes

tile_path.description: Optional tlog-tiles path, <prefix>/tile/<L>/<N>[.p/<W>], checked for consistency with the leaf index

mcp_tool_definition.name: verify_c2sp_tlog_checkpoint
mcp_tool_definition.description: Verifies a C2SP checkpoint signed note, its witness cosignature quorum against a tlog-policy trust policy, and an RFC 6962 inclusion proof against the checkpoint root. Browser-based, client-side only, zero network calls, zero PII.

policy.description: C2SP tlog-policy text naming the log and witness keys and the quorum rule

proof.description: RFC 6962 inclusion proof: leaf value, leaf index, bottom-up sibling path

tile_path.description: Optional tlog-tiles path for the tile the leaf was read from
